payout_quote: Earn up to $50 when you open a Launch Checking account. Earn $10 - Direct Deposit Bonus: When at least 3 direct deposits totaling a minimum of $1,500 credit to this account within the qualifying bonus period. Earn $10 - Bill Pay Bonus: When 9 Bill Pay transactions to service providers clear/debit this account within the qualifying bonus period. Earn $10 - Mobile Deposit Bonus: Make 3 mobile deposits that clear the account within the qualifying bonus period. Earn $10 - Zelle Bonus: Sign up and pay/receive at least 8 times via Zelle within the qualifying bonus period. Earn $10 - Point of Sale Transaction Bonus: When 30 one time or recurring Point-of-Sale (POS) transactions clear/debit this account within the qualifying bonus period.
steps: Open a new Launch Checking account online or in a branch ($0 minimum opening deposit; 18+, application approval).
Within the qualifying bonus period: (a) have 3+ direct deposits totaling $1,500+ for $10.
(b) make 9+ Bill Pay transactions to service providers for $10.
Keep the account open and active; bonuses credit per official schedule after the bonus period.
catches: Each leg pays only $10; the full $50 requires completing all five activity legs.
$0 monthly service charge and $0 minimum opening deposit - cheapest TBK product to hold.
Bonuses are per the qualifying bonus period (120 days per TBK program pattern); account must be open and active at crediting.
No stated expiry; offer subject to change at any time.
Converted accounts are not eligible (per TBK bonus program terms).
Cash bonus payments may be reported to the IRS as interest (taxable).
biggest_catch: Each leg pays just $10 and the full $50 demands all five behaviors (direct deposits, bill pays, mobile deposits, Zelle, 30 POS purchases) within the qualifying period - low payout but zero fees to hold.
eligibility: New Launch Checking customers 18+; converted accounts not eligible. Subject to application approval.
timing: Bonuses credited after the qualifying bonus period. No expiry stated.
